decision_question: After repairing owner-generated identity and full-wrapper version routing, can Completion Integrity activate once on two fresh qualified Codex roots, and are B0/T1 reporter claims valid and accurate without crossing the evidence-only boundary?

primary_estimand.name: exact fresh-root reporter agreement vector
primary_estimand.description: Record B0 and T1 terminal-claim validity/agreement separately on each fresh sacrificial task root; no population effect is estimated.
primary_estimand.aggregation: Exact counts by condition across two roots with non-compensating protocol-integrity gates and no inferential interval.

conditions.delta_from_baseline: Reference reporter instruction over shared sealed evidence and output schema.

conditions.delta_from_baseline: Adds fixed requirement reconciliation; model, effort, evidence, schema, image, budget, and capability boundary remain matched.

contamination_notes: Both roots are new maintainer-authored sacrificial calibration artifacts and are not screening or confirmation units.
The first qualification run exposed a version-identity defect in its generated receipt and is retained as invalid evidence.
The second qualification used version-derived identities and passed eight challenge cases with two deterministic evaluator repeats per case on both roots.

budget.description: B0/T1 share model, effort, sealed evidence, schema, reporter image, and limits. E0 is a common upstream calibration call.

dimensions.rule: Submit every frozen cell at most once; no resume or outcome retry after submission.
A timeout is retained as an ambiguous protocol stop.
A timeout is retained as an ambiguous protocol stop.

adaptation_boundary.description: After preregistration, no task, evaluator, prompt, schema, adapter, image, model, schedule, budget, capture, claim, or decision rule changes in response to output.

selection_rules: This activation governs only whether the exact v3 adapter may enter further task-supply development.
Eligibility requires valid complete capture on both roots, four valid isolated reporter cells, T1 agreement on both roots, and no lower T1 agreement count than B0.
No effect, reliability, model superiority, transfer, production, or independent-reproduction claim may be selected from two roots.
stop_rules: Stop before execution if any freeze binding differs from current bytes or image identity.

Stop after any ambiguous submission, timeout without terminal evidence, credential persistence, evidence mutation, forbidden mount, evaluator operational failure, output-limit breach, or identity mismatch.
Never retry or resume a submitted cell; preserve negative, null, harmful, invalid, missing, and partial outcomes.

role_overlaps: Kizz authored the method, sacrificial tasks, deterministic evaluators, adapters, analysis, and owner decision; no independent selection, evaluation, or replication exists.
